event_chain.summary: Records posted to a public website

summary: Star Hospitals in Hyderabad, India found that patient medical records, personal details, employee information and confidential internal documents had been uploaded to a public website and made available to others, with login credentials for the site circulated in a message. The CEO filed a complaint with the Telangana Cyber Security Bureau, which registered a case in early August 2026. The hospital said a Chennai-based company manages its data.
